description: deepin 25 with the Deepin Desktop Environment (DDE), an integrated app store, and an immutable system core. Safe automated installation alongside Windows is still under investigation in iGloo.

maintainer.note: Blocked integration; see distros/deepin/STATUS.md. The 25.2.0 AMD64 ISO and SHA-256 were verified against the official release directory and local image on 2026-09-08. That directory lists no signature; the pin is not a verified publisher signature. Four GiB RAM is the documented VM floor; eight GiB is recommended. UEFI is the intended iGloo scope. No safe root-only installation or migration agent has been validated.
